Glossary

Web hosting: what is it, and why does every website need it?

Web hosting is space rented on a computer that never switches off, keeping your website available to everyone. Without it, your web address leads nowhere.

The definition in one sentence

Hosting is the plot of land your website is built on. The text, photos and code are stored there, then sent to the phone of every visitor who types your address.

The term web host also refers to the company that rents out this space. It looks after the machines, the electricity, the cooling and the internet connection.

What it does for a small business

Picture a bakery. The domain name is the sign above the door. Hosting is the shop itself. A sign without a shop is useless, and nobody finds a shop without a sign.

In practice, good hosting gives you:

  • A website that responds quickly, even at times when lots of people are looking.
  • A website that is always online, with no outage on a Sunday evening.
  • Safety copies, so you can go back if something goes wrong.
  • Protection against robots trying to get into poorly guarded websites.

A real-life example

A florist picks very cheap hosting for her website. All goes well until Valentine's Day: the website crawls, pages won't open, and customers order elsewhere. The problem wasn't the website, but the machine that was too small to run it.

What you need to know

  • The cheapest often costs more later. Slow hosting drives visitors away and weighs on your position in Google.
  • Check who owns it. The contract should be in your name, or your provider's should state that you get everything back.
  • It needs renewing. Unpaid hosting means a website that vanishes overnight.

Hosting and the domain name are two different things, often sold separately. Having one doesn't mean you have the other.

At Alex & Lia

I don't ask you to look for a web host. All the plans include hosting on a quality server, and the Power plan moves to a faster server. There is no separate bill and nothing to set up. To understand what the machine itself is, read the definition of a server.

Your questions

Can you have a website without hosting?

No. A website has to sit somewhere to be visible. Some platforms include hosting in their subscription, but it is always there, even when you can't see it.

How much does hosting cost?

Prices vary a lot depending on power and service. With me, it is included in the plan, from €5 a month, which also covers your domain name and website upkeep.

Can I change web host later?

Yes. The website's files are copied to the new web host, then the domain name is pointed to it. Done properly, your visitors won't notice the change.
